title: Full-Page Optical Music Recognition of Handwritten Monophonic Scores
abstract: arXiv:2609.05662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full-page end-to-end Optical Music Recognition seeks to transcribe entire music pages directly into symbolic notation, avoiding the limitations of traditional pipelines that rely on accurate staff segmentation. Recent Transformer-based architectures have achieved strong performance on typeset scores, relying on large-scale synthetic data for pretraining. However, their applicability to handwritten music remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study full-page transcription on handwritten monophonic collections and analyze the impact of synthetic pretraining in this setting. To investigate which factors are most relevant during pretraining, we introduce a generator capable of producing visually coherent full-page scores in both typeset and handwritten styles. translated_title: 手写单声部乐谱的全页光学音乐识别
translated_abstract: 全页端到端光学音乐识别旨在将整页乐谱直接转录为符号化记谱，从而避免传统流程中依赖精确五线谱分割的局限性。近年来基于Transformer的架构在印刷体乐谱上取得了优异的性能，其依赖于大规模合成数据进行预训练。然而，这类方法在手写乐谱上的适用性在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本工作中，我们研究了手写单声部乐谱合集上的全页转录任务，并分析了合成数据预训练在该场景下的影响。为了探究预训练过程中哪些因素最为关键，我们引入了一个生成器，能够生成视觉上连贯的印刷体和手写体风格的全页乐谱。在三个真实手写数据集上的实验为多种全页处理流程和不同的合成数据预训练策略提供了对比评估。结果表明……
tldr: 本文研究手写单声部乐谱的全页端到端光学音乐识别，提出了一种可生成印刷体和手写体风格全页乐谱的合成数据生成器，并系统评估了不同合成预训练策略在该任务中的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper studies full-page end-to-end optical music recognition on handwritten monophonic scores, introducing a generator that produces visually coherent full-page scores in both typeset and handwritten styles to analyze the impact of synthetic pretraining strategies.
